response.sql: WITH event_averages AS (SELECT corpeventprx, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_analyst_reports, AVG(inholdpct - instownpct) AS avg_gap FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY corpeventprx), compared AS (SELECT corpeventprx, avg_analyst_reports, avg_gap, AVG(avg_gap) OVER () AS overall_avg_gap FROM event_averages) SELECT corpeventprx, avg_analyst_reports, avg_gap, avg_gap - overall_avg_gap AS gap_vs_event_type_average FROM compared WHERE overall_avg_gap IS NOT NULL

assumptions.assumption: The gap is insider ownership minus institutional ownership for each snapshot; snapshots with either percentage missing do not contribute to the average gap.

alternatives.interpretation: If gap means the absolute difference between the two ownership percentages, average that absolute difference for each event type.
alternatives.sql: WITH event_averages AS (SELECT corpeventprx, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_analyst_reports, AVG(ABS(inholdpct - instownpct)) AS avg_gap FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY corpeventprx), compared AS (SELECT corpeventprx, avg_analyst_reports, avg_gap, AVG(avg_gap) OVER () AS overall_avg_gap FROM event_averages) SELECT corpeventprx, avg_analyst_reports, avg_gap, avg_gap - overall_avg_gap AS gap_vs_event_type_average FROM compared WHERE overall_avg_gap IS NOT NULL
